ἔτ: ἔτι — still, any longer, further; adv., elided (ἔτ’); οὐδ’ ἔτ’ ’nor any more’
ἔφατ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented, elided (ἔφατ’ = ἔφατο)
ἕκαστος: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. nom. sg.
ἕκτορος: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam, chief Trojan hero; masc. gen. sg.
ἕκτωρ: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. nom. sg.
ἕλε: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic εἷλε)
ἕλοιεν: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. opt. 3 pl. act.: ’might take’, in a fear clause after μή · also aor. opt. 3 pl., after εἰς ὅ κ’: ’until … should take’
ἕλῃ: αἱρέω — take, seize; in battle, kill; aor. subj. 3 sg., after εἰ κεν: ’takes, kills’ · also aor. subj. 3 sg., in a purpose clause after ἵνα: ’he may take’
ἕνα: εἷς, μία, ἕν — one; masc. acc. sg.: ’a single’ (ἕνα μῆνα ’a single month’); ’one’ (ἕνα καὶ δύο ’one and two’)
ἕπευ: ἕπομαι — follow, accompany; pres. imper. 2 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἕπου): ’follow!’
ἕταρον: ἑταῖρος (epic ἕταρος) — companion, comrade; masc. acc. sg.
ἠμείβετ: ἀμείβω — exchange; mid. answer, reply; impf. 3 sg. mid., elided (ἠμείβετ’ = ἠμείβετο)
ἠμὲν: ἠμέν — both (epic correlative, ἠμέν … ἠδέ ’both … and’); conj.
ἠὲ: ἠέ — or; epic conj. (= Attic ἤ), correlative with ἠέ · also ’than’ after a comparative (γλυκίων … ἠὲ νέεσθαι ’sweeter than to go home’) · also ’whether’, introducing an indirect question (ἠὲ φυλάσσονται νῆες ’whether the ships are guarded’; ἠὲ κατ’ αἶσαν ἔειπον ’whether I spoke in due measure’)
ἡμῖν: ἐγώ (pl. ἡμεῖς) — I, we; dat. pl. ’to us’
ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj.; ἢ … ἤ ’either … or’ · also ’than’ after a comparative · also introducing the first alternative of an indirect question: ’whether’ (ἢ ἐτεὸν … ἦε ’whether truly … or’) · also after πρίν, ’before’ (πρίν γ’ ἢ ’before …’) · also in τί ἢ δέ, a form of τίη δέ: ’why then’ · also ’than, except’ after ἄλλος (ἄλλῳ γ’ ἢ Ἀχιλῆϊ ’than Achilles’) · also in τί ἢ ἐμέ, a form of τίη: ’why’ (τί ἢ ἐμὲ ταῦτα διεξερέεσθε ’why do you ask me these things’) · also ἢ = ἦ, ’truly, surely’ (ἐπεὶ ἢ πολὺ φέρτεροί ’for they are truly far better’)
ἢν: ἐάν (ἤν) — if (= εἰ + ἄν); conj. + subj.; ἢν μή ’unless’
ἣν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (fem. acc. sg.)
ἤλυθον: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. 1 sg., augmented, epic root ἐλυθ- with epenthetic -υ- (= Attic ἦλθον): ’I came’ · also aor. 3 pl.: ’they came, advanced’
ἤρκεσε: ἀρκέω — ward off, avail, suffice; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented, + acc.: ’warded off’
ἦ: ἦ — truly, surely; affirming particle; ἦ μέν in oaths · also an interrogative particle · also ἠμί — say; impf. 3 sg. ἦ ’he said’, in ἦ καί, ἦ ῥα · also ἦ = ἤ, ’or’ (εἰ … ἦ ’whether … or’) · also ἦ … ἦ ’either … or’
ἦλθεν: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. 3 sg., augmented: ’came’
ἰδών: ὁράω (aor. εἶδον) — see; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having seen’
ἰφθίμῳ: ἴφθιμος — mighty, stout; adj. of two endings, neut. dat. sg. · also masc. dat. sg., agreeing with μοί: ’(me) mighty’
ἱπποδασείης: ἱπποδασύς — horse-haired, thick with horsehair; fem. ἱπποδασεῖα, gen. sg., epic -είης (= Attic -είας)
ἴδον: ὁράω — see; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented, from the root of εἶδον (= εἶδον): ’I saw’ · also aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= εἶδον): ’they saw’
ἴλιον: Ἴλιος — Ilios, Troy; fem. acc. sg.
ἴφθιμον: ἴφθιμος — stout, strong, mighty; masc. acc. sg.
ἵξεσθαι: ἱκνέομαι — come to, reach, arrive at; fut. inf. mid./dep. (ἵξομαι), in indirect statement after ἔφαντο: ’that he would come’ · also after ἔμελλεν: ’was about to reach’
ἵππουριν: ἵππουρις — with a horsehair plume; adj., fem. acc. sg.
ἶσα: ἴσος — equal; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’equally’
ὀνόμαζεν: ὀνομάζω — call by name, name; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ὠνόμαζε); with ἐκ in tmesis (ἔκ … ὀνόμαζεν) ’called by name’
ὀξέϊ: ὀξύς — sharp, keen; masc./neut. dat. sg., epic ὀξέϊ (= Attic ὀξεῖ)
ὀξυόεντι: ὀξυόεις — sharp, pointed; neut. dat. sg., epic -όεντι, agreeing with ἔγχεϊ · also neut. dat. sg., agreeing with δουρί: ’sharp’ (δουρὶ … ὀξυόεντι ’with a sharp spear’)
ὀπίσσω: ὀπίσσω — behind, backward, afterwards; adv. (= ὀπίσω)
ὀτρύνοντος: ὀτρύνω — urge on, spur; pres. part. masc. gen. sg., as the genitive of the person heard after ἀκούω: ’(heed him) urging’
ὀφθαλμοῖσιν: ὀφθαλμός — eye; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν)
ὁράᾳς: ὁράω — see; pres. 2 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὁρᾷς)
ὁρμηθείς: ὁρμάω — set in motion, rush; aor. pass. part. masc. nom. sg., passive in form, active in sense: ’having rushed’
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’) · also masc. nom. sg. in the correlative ὃ μὲν … ὃ δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ὃ πάϊς ’the child’) · also masc. nom. sg., ’the one’ set against a genitive ’the other’ (πρὸ ὃ τοῦ ’before the other’)
ὃν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc./neut. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (masc. acc. sg.)
ὃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also plain demonstrative, ’he’ (ὃς γὰρ δεύτατος ἦλθεν), not a relative
ὄλεθρον: ὄλεθρος — destruction, ruin, death; masc. acc. sg., object of ἐπήρκεσε · also masc. acc. sg., object of βούλευσαν and of φύγοι: ’destruction’
ὄπισθεν: ὄπισθεν — behind, from behind; adv. · also of time: ’afterwards, hereafter’
ὄρνυθι: ὄρνυμι — rouse, stir up; pres. imper. act. 2 sg.: ’rouse!’
ὄτρυνε: ὀτρύνω — urge on, rouse; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ὤτρυνε): ’urged on’
ὄφρα: ὄφρα — so that, in order that (+ subj.) · also temporal, ’until, while’ · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρα νέμοιτο ’so that he might enjoy’) · also + fut. indic. in a purpose clause: ’so that … will’ (ὄφρα … εἴσεται ’so that … will know’)
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., with γε ’he’ · also relative neut. ’which’; ὅ τι ’whatever, why’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of seeing: ’that’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of emotion: ’that, because’ (χωόμενος ὅ τ’ … ’angry that …’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of knowing: ’that’ (ὅ τ’ ἄριστον … οὐδὲν ἔτισεν) · also εἰς ὅ (κεν) + subj., ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … ἕλωμεν ’until we take’) · also masc. nom. sg. ’he’ without γε (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’) · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. sg., ’who’ (ὅ με … κάκ’ ἔοργε ’who did me wrong’) · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like (demonstrative): ’the’ (ὅ τ’ ἀεργὸς ἀνήρ ’the idle man’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of thinking: ’that, because’ (τὰ φρονέων ὅ μοι … ’thinking on these things, that to me …’) · also εἰς ὅ κε + pres. subj. of duration: ’as long as’ (εἰς ὅ κ’ ἀϋτμὴ … μένῃ ’as long as breath remains’)
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic · also ὅς τις as an indirect interrogative: ’who’ (ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’)
ὑμέων: σύ — you; pl. ὑμεῖς, gen. pl. ὑμέων, epic (= Attic ὑμῶν), partitive: ’of you’
ὑπ: ὑπό (elided ὑπ’) — under, beneath; + gen.: ’from under’ (ὑπ’ ἀνθερεῶνος) · also + gen. of the agent or cause, ’under’ (ἀϋσάντων ὑπ’ Ἀχαιῶν ’as the Achaeans shouted’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπ’ Ἀδμήτῳ τέκε ’bore to Admetus’) · also + dat., ’under’ (ὑπ’ ἠελίῳ ’under the sun’) · also + acc. of motion, ’under’ (ὑπ’ ὀστέον ’under the bone’) · also + acc., ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ ἠῶ ’beneath the dawn’) · also + dat., of those under whom men fall: ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ ἀνδράσι … πέσοιεν ’fall beneath men’) · also + gen., ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ αὐτοῦ ’beneath him’) · also ὑπ’ ἐκ + gen., ’out from under’ (ὑπ’ ἐκ κακοῦ ’out from under evil’)
ὑπέρτερον: ὑπέρτερος — higher, greater, superior; comparative adj., neut. acc. sg.
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’ · also introducing a wish, with ὄφελεν: ’would that’ (ὡς ὄφελεν θάνατός μοι ἁδεῖν ’would that death had pleased me’) · also in a comparison, ’like, just as’ (ὡς ὅδε οἶνος ’like this wine’) · also ὡς εἴ, ’as if’ (ὡς εἴ τι κακὸν ῥέζουσαν ’as if doing some evil’) · also correlative with ὣς: ’as surely as’ (ὣς … ὡς, in a wish like an oath) · also adverb, demonstrative: ’so, in that way’ (ὡς ἂν … οὐκ ἐθέλοιμι ’so I would not wish’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’) · also correlative ὣς … ὡς, ’so surely … as’ (in a wish like an oath)
ὤμοισι: ὦμος — shoulder; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
ὦκα: ὦκα — quickly, swiftly; adv., from ὠκύς
ὧδ: ὧδε — thus, so, in this way; adv., elided (ὧδ’ = ὧδε)
ῥ: ἄρα — then, indeed, so; inferential particle, weak form ῥα, elided (ῥ’ = ῥα)
ῥεῖα: ῥεῖα — easily, lightly; adv. (= Attic ῥᾳδίως)
ῥῆξε: ῥήγνυμι — break, burst; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔρρηξε): ’broke’
